name: Muse

whyMatters.en: Teignmouth trio that scaled prog/alt riffs, arp synths, and Matt Bellamy’s falsetto into 2000s arena rock—Absolution (2003) and Black Holes and Revelations (2006) are the UK stadium template beside Radiohead’s experimental fork.
whyMatters.zh: 廷茅斯三人组：把 prog/alt riff、arp 合成器与 Matt Bellamy 假声扩成 2000 年代体育场摇滚——Absolution（2003）与 Black Holes and Revelations（2006）是英国体育场模板，与 Radiohead 实验分叉并列。

lyricQuotes: Come ride with me / Through the veins of history
My circuits blown by my mind

shortBio.en: Matt Bellamy trio; compressed guitars, arp synths, falsetto leads—Knights of Cydonia the Morricone arena single.
shortBio.zh: Matt Bellamy 三人组；压缩吉他、arp 合成器、假声主音——Knights of Cydonia 是 Morricone 体育场单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1994 in Teignmouth. Origin of Symmetry (2001) and Absolution (2003) built the template—heavily compressed guitars, arp synths, operatic falsetto, conspiracy/sci-fi lyric frames. Rich Costey mixes push mid-range punch.

Black Holes and Revelations (2006) added Morricone western pastiche on Knights of Cydonia. Same UK generation as Radiohead, opposite lane: crowd-chant stadium design over experimental retreat.
body.zh:
1994 年于廷茅斯组建。Origin of Symmetry（2001）与 Absolution（2003）建立模板——高压缩吉他、arp 合成器、歌剧式假声、阴谋/科幻歌词框架。Rich Costey 混音推中频冲击。

Black Holes and Revelations（2006）在 Knights of Cydonia 加入 Morricone 西部拼贴。与 Radiohead 同代，相反车道：集体口号体育场设计，而非实验撤退。

note.zh: Morricone 拼贴、多段单曲；Black Holes 最大化峰值。

title.en: Prog-riff arena rock at maximum compression
title.zh: 最大压缩下的 prog-riff 体育场摇滚

body.en:
Plug In Baby and Hysteria show the method: fuzz/tap guitar, Wolstenholme bass as melody, Howard’s four-on-floor drive. Bellamy falsetto carries sci-fi/conspiracy frames.

Absolution is the UK alt arena grammar—loud, mid-forward, chant-ready.
body.zh:
Plug In Baby 与 Hysteria 展示方法：fuzz/点弦吉他、Wolstenholme 贝斯作旋律、Howard 四拍驱动。Bellamy 假声承载科幻/阴谋框架。

Absolution 是英国 alt 体育场语法——大声、中频前置、口号就绪。

body.en:
Bellamy handles guitar, keys, and primary vocals; Wolstenholme bass/vocals; Howard drums. No permanent fourth member—live keyboards and guitar techs fill stage width.

Same three names from bedroom demos to Wembley.
body.zh:
Bellamy 负责吉他、键盘与主唱；Wolstenholme 贝斯/和声；Howard 鼓。无固定第四成员——现场键盘与吉他 tech 撑舞台宽度。

从卧室 demo 到 Wembley 仍是三个名字。

body.en:
Radiohead moved toward experimental/electronic retreat; Muse doubled down on riff, synth arp, and falsetto arena scale. Knights of Cydonia is the citation for maximal UK alt rock in 2006.

Queen and Rush pastiche as deliberate production choice, not hidden influence.
body.zh:
Radiohead 走向实验/电子撤退；Muse 加倍 riff、合成器 arp 与假声体育场体量。Knights of Cydonia 是 2006 年英国 alt 最大化摇滚引用。

Queen 与 Rush 拼贴是刻意制作选择，非隐藏影响。
